Bayesian copula sampler

Metropolis-within-Gibbs sampler for the Bayesian Gaussian copula endogeneity correction of Haschka (2025).

CopRegBAYES()
Bayesian Gaussian copula endogeneity correction

Checking the identifying assumptions
